description: A limit the code enforces on a run: steps, tokens, cost, wall time or repetition.
A structured value (`done`, `max_cost`, `stuck`...) plus a readable detail that says why a run ended, so callers can react and dashboards can count.
The token counts and cost the provider returns with each response; the numbers that match the invoice.
Stopping a run when the same tool call (same name, same normalized arguments) repeats several times in a row.
A normalized identity for a tool call: its name plus its arguments serialized with sorted keys.
A `now()` function passed in instead of reading the system time, so time limits are deterministic in tests.
